You are implementing the CORE of Phase 5 (final phase) of Happy Dog Runner — a Phaser 3 + TypeScript + Vite 2D browser runner (landscape 1280x720, static hosting, no backend). Phases 1-4 are merged. TypeScript is STRICT — keep it green. Do NOT run `npm run gen:placeholders` (it clobbers the final SVG art).

DEPLOY CONTEXT: the demo ships to a GitHub Pages PROJECT page for repo inn0minatus/HappyDog, served at https://inn0minatus.github.io/HappyDog/ (subpath /HappyDog/). Deploy is a LOCAL gh-pages-branch push (no CI) — a separate node owns the deploy tooling + README; YOU own the base + asset-URL correctness (deliverable 5).

READ FIRST:
- docs/2d-browser-runner-spec.md §7 (Analytics: 3-event contract §7.2, exact param shapes, GA4 gtag + Meta Pixel fbq mapping), §10.1 (perf/pooling), §10.4 (a11y), §11 (client-dependent open items).
- src/analytics/track.ts (typed 3-event skeleton, safe no-ops, consent hook — MAKE IT DISPATCH FOR REAL).
- src/config/env.ts (ENV.ga4Id / ENV.fbPixelId currently UNCONSUMED; buildBuyUrl() appends UTM; buyDestination()).
- index.html (commented GA4/Meta Pixel snippet placeholders gated on VITE_* env).
- src/scenes/GameScene.ts (start_game in create(), finish_game in endRun()), src/scenes/ResultsScene.ts (click_buy in onBuy()). Do NOT move these call sites or change their param shapes.
- src/systems/audio.ts (9 synthesized WAV blob object URLs — currently never revoked).
- The Preload scene + src/config/assetManifest.ts (how load.svg/load.audio URLs are built). vite.config.ts (base currently './'). .env.example, src/config/gameConfig.ts.

SCOPE — you OWN deliverables 1-5 below. Do NOT touch README or the deploy tooling (gh-pages/package scripts/.nojekyll) — a separate node owns those.

1. REAL ANALYTICS DISPATCH (the core):
- Make track(event, params) actually dispatch each of the 3 events to BOTH GA4 (gtag) and Meta Pixel (fbq), mapping event names + params EXACTLY per spec §7.2. Events: start_game (no params), finish_game {result:'win'|'lose', score, duration_s}, click_buy {destination, promo_code}.
- Conditionally LOAD the GA4 (gtag.js) and Meta Pixel base snippets ONLY when their IDs are present and non-placeholder (ENV.ga4Id / ENV.fbPixelId). Prefer a single analytics init() invoked ONCE at app boot that injects the vendor <script> tags at runtime, gated on the IDs — keeps the mechanism in TS and lets it cleanly no-op. Pick ONE coherent path (don't double-load with index.html).
- When IDs are absent/empty/placeholder: everything is a SAFE NO-OP — no network, no console errors, no thrown exceptions. Guard every gtag/fbq call (typeof check) so a missing vendor global never throws. Add a small isConfigured/isPlaceholder helper (treat empty string AND the example placeholder values in .env.example, e.g. G-XXXXXXXXXX / a 000... pixel id, as NOT configured).
- Respect the existing consent hook: do not dispatch (and ideally do not load vendor scripts) before consent is granted. Preserve its current semantics.
- Keep it fully typed (window.gtag/fbq/dataLayer augmentations as needed). Robust and self-contained.

2. PROMO + CTA finalize (src/config/env.ts buildBuyUrl):
- Add the promo code as a query param on the buy URL (Phase 4 shows/copies the promo but it's NOT yet on the URL). Use the promo code from ENV; sensible param name (e.g. promo=) unless spec specifies one. Confirm the UTM params (utm_source/medium/campaign from ENV) are still appended and the final URL is well-formed (proper encoding, single '?'). The click_buy flow is ResultsScene.onBuy() -> window.open(buildBuyUrl(),'_blank','noopener') -> tabletki.ua; verify it carries BOTH promo + UTM.

3. ENV finalize (.env.example ONLY — the README is another node's job):
- Document EVERY VITE_* var the app reads: GA4 id, Meta Pixel id, promo code, buy URL base (default a tabletki.ua product URL), UTM source/medium/campaign. One clear comment per var on what the CLIENT must supply. Keep sensible PLACEHOLDER defaults so `npm run build` and the app work with NO .env (safe analytics no-op). Ensure env.ts and .env.example agree on var names exactly.

4. PERF / A11Y (SMALL fixes only; §10):
- Audio blob-URL cleanup: revoke the 9 synthesized WAV object URLs via URL.revokeObjectURL — but ONLY after Phaser has finished loading/decoding each one (e.g. in the loader filecomplete/complete callback) so playback is NOT broken. Verify no leak remains.
- Verify object pooling (src/systems + src/entities) has no leaks and no per-frame allocation in steady state; fix a real leak/allocation if found, otherwise note it's clean.
- A11y basics (§10.4): ensure interactive/tap targets meet a reasonable min size, check obvious HUD/menu/results text color-contrast, and add a CHEAP prefers-reduced-motion consideration where trivial. Small fixes only — no redesign. Note anything needing a real device.

5. VITE BASE + RUNTIME ASSET-URL CORRECTNESS (this is a code/build-correctness matter, coupled with the subpath deploy):
- Set the Vite `base` in vite.config.ts to '/HappyDog/' (absolute) — the app serves under the /HappyDog/ subpath on GitHub Pages. This is the user's explicit choice.
- CRITICAL: because the app now serves under /HappyDog/, ensure EVERY runtime asset URL resolves under that base. Vite auto-rewrites asset refs it processes in index.html + JS imports, but RUNTIME string URLs passed to Phaser (load.svg / load.audio in the Preload scene + src/config/assetManifest.ts) are NOT processed by Vite — any root-absolute '/assets/...' will 404 under the subpath. Make them base-aware: prefix with import.meta.env.BASE_URL (e.g. `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}assets/<group>/<key>.svg`) or otherwise guarantee they resolve under /HappyDog/. Also check the favicon / any hardcoded refs in index.html.
- Verify: run `npm run build`, inspect dist/index.html (asset URLs should be /HappyDog/assets/...), and confirm by reading the loader code that runtime SVG/audio URLs will resolve under /HappyDog/. If feasible, `npm run preview` (Vite preview serves at the base) as a sanity check.

VALIDATION:
- `npm run typecheck` AND `npm run build` must BOTH exit 0.
- Verify the analytics DISPATCH PATH: reason through (or briefly test) that with a dummy GA4 + Pixel id, gtag/fbq WOULD be invoked with the correct event name + mapped params for all 3 events; and that with empty/placeholder ids nothing loads and no call throws. Do NOT commit any real/dummy id — leave placeholders in .env.example.

RETURN a structured summary: (a) files changed (path + one line each); (b) the exact analytics mapping per event — GA4 call+params and Pixel call+params — with a §7.2 conformance note; (c) the complete VITE_* var list (name + purpose + placeholder default); (d) the promo query-param name + an example final buy URL string; (e) perf/a11y: changed vs verified-clean vs needs-real-device; (f) the vite base set + how runtime asset URLs are made base-aware + a sample dist/index.html asset path; (g) typecheck + build exit codes; (h) any residual concern for the reviewer.

## 7. Analytics & Tracking Spec

### 7.1 Adapter design

A **thin `track(event, params)` adapter** is the single choke point for all analytics. Game code never calls `gtag`/`fbq` directly — it calls `track()`, which fans out to **GA4 (gtag)** and **Meta Pixel (fbq)**.

```ts
type AnalyticsEvent = 'start_game' | 'finish_game' | 'click_buy';

function track(event: AnalyticsEvent, params: Record<string, unknown> = {}): void {
  // GA4
  window.gtag?.('event', event, params);
  // Meta Pixel — custom events via trackCustom
  window.fbq?.('trackCustom', event, params);
  // Dev/QA: console mirror when a debug flag is on
  if (DEBUG_ANALYTICS) console.debug('[track]', event, params);
}
```

Rationale:
- **One contract, two sinks.** Adding/removing a sink (or a consent gate) is a one-file change.
- **Safe if a pixel is absent.** Optional chaining means a missing/blocked `gtag`/`fbq` never throws (ad-blockers are common on the audience).
- **Testable.** Event emission can be asserted in isolation.

### 7.2 Event / parameter contract

#### `start_game` — a round begins

| Param | Type | Required | Example | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| *(none required)* | — | — | — | Fired once when the Play scene starts the run |

#### `finish_game` — fires on BOTH Victory and Game Over

| Param | Type | Required | Example | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `result` | `'win' \| 'lose'` | ✅ | `'win'` | `win` = reached finish; `lose` = 0 HP |
| `score` | integer | ✅ | `1450` | Final score at round end |
| `duration_s` | integer (seconds) | ✅ | `72` | **Active play time, excluding paused time.** Measured by accumulating elapsed time each frame while the run is playing; the accumulator is **frozen while paused** (§6.3) so paused time never inflates it. Reported at round end |

#### `click_buy` — CTA tapped on results screen

| Param | Type | Required | Example | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `destination` | string | ✅ | `'tabletki.ua'` | Fixed for MVP |
| `promo_code` | string | ✅ | `'DOG10'` | The code shown on the CTA (see §11) |

> All three event **names** are fixed by the brief (§3B: `start_game`, `finish_game`, `click_buy`) — do not rename.

### 7.3 GA4 (gtag) + Meta Pixel (fbq) wiring

- Both snippets load in `index.html` `<head>` (standard install), parameterized by **GA4 Measurement ID** and **Meta Pixel ID** (see §11 — needed before launch).
- IDs injected via Vite env vars (`VITE_GA4_ID`, `VITE_FB_PIXEL_ID`) so staging/prod differ without code edits.
- GA4 receives events via `gtag('event', …)`; Meta Pixel via `fbq('trackCustom', …)`. (Meta standard events like `Purchase` are **not** used — the brief's three custom names take priority; a `Purchase` mapping can be added later if the client wants Ads Manager optimization on it.)
- **GA4 custom dimensions/metrics:** the custom params (`result`, `score`, `duration_s`, `destination`, `promo_code`) must be **registered as custom dimensions/metrics in the GA4 property** (GA4 Admin → Custom definitions) or they will be collected but **won't surface in GA4 reports**. Register `result`/`destination`/`promo_code` as dimensions and `score`/`duration_s` as metrics as part of launch setup.

### 7.4 Consent / GDPR note

- The audience is EU-adjacent (Ukraine); ad pixels imply personal-data processing.
- **Recommendation:** a lightweight consent gate. `track()` is the natural enforcement point — buffer or drop events until consent is granted, and only initialize `fbq`/`gtag` post-consent (Consent Mode v2 for GA4).
- Exact consent UX / whether a CMP is required depends on the client's legal stance — **flag in §11.** MVP ships the adapter consent-ready even if the banner is deferred.

---

## 7. Analytics & Tracking Spec

### 7.1 Adapter design

A **thin `track(event, params)` adapter** is the single choke point for all analytics. Game code never calls `gtag`/`fbq` directly — it calls `track()`, which fans out to **GA4 (gtag)** and **Meta Pixel (fbq)**.

```ts
type AnalyticsEvent = 'start_game' | 'finish_game' | 'click_buy';

function track(event: AnalyticsEvent, params: Record<string, unknown> = {}): void {
  // GA4
  window.gtag?.('event', event, params);
  // Meta Pixel — custom events via trackCustom
  window.fbq?.('trackCustom', event, params);
  // Dev/QA: console mirror when a debug flag is on
  if (DEBUG_ANALYTICS) console.debug('[track]', event, params);
}
```

Rationale:
- **One contract, two sinks.** Adding/removing a sink (or a consent gate) is a one-file change.
- **Safe if a pixel is absent.** Optional chaining means a missing/blocked `gtag`/`fbq` never throws (ad-blockers are common on the audience).
- **Testable.** Event emission can be asserted in isolation.

### 7.2 Event / parameter contract

#### `start_game` — a round begins

| Param | Type | Required | Example | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| *(none required)* | — | — | — | Fired once when the Play scene starts the run |

#### `finish_game` — fires on BOTH Victory and Game Over

| Param | Type | Required | Example | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `result` | `'win' \| 'lose'` | ✅ | `'win'` | `win` = reached finish; `lose` = 0 HP |
| `score` | integer | ✅ | `1450` | Final score at round end |
| `duration_s` | integer (seconds) | ✅ | `72` | **Active play time, excluding paused time.** Measured by accumulating elapsed time each frame while the run is playing; the accumulator is **frozen while paused** (§6.3) so paused time never inflates it. Reported at round end |

#### `click_buy` — CTA tapped on results screen

| Param | Type | Required | Example | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `destination` | string | ✅ | `'tabletki.ua'` | Fixed for MVP |
| `promo_code` | string | ✅ | `'DOG10'` | The code shown on the CTA (see §11) |

> All three event **names** are fixed by the brief (§3B: `start_game`, `finish_game`, `click_buy`) — do not rename.

### 7.3 GA4 (gtag) + Meta Pixel (fbq) wiring

- Both snippets load in `index.html` `<head>` (standard install), parameterized by **GA4 Measurement ID** and **Meta Pixel ID** (see §11 — needed before launch).
- IDs injected via Vite env vars (`VITE_GA4_ID`, `VITE_FB_PIXEL_ID`) so staging/prod differ without code edits.
- GA4 receives events via `gtag('event', …)`; Meta Pixel via `fbq('trackCustom', …)`. (Meta standard events like `Purchase` are **not** used — the brief's three custom names take priority; a `Purchase` mapping can be added later if the client wants Ads Manager optimization on it.)
- **GA4 custom dimensions/metrics:** the custom params (`result`, `score`, `duration_s`, `destination`, `promo_code`) must be **registered as custom dimensions/metrics in the GA4 property** (GA4 Admin → Custom definitions) or they will be collected but **won't surface in GA4 reports**. Register `result`/`destination`/`promo_code` as dimensions and `score`/`duration_s` as metrics as part of launch setup.

### 7.4 Consent / GDPR note

- The audience is EU-adjacent (Ukraine); ad pixels imply personal-data processing.
- **Recommendation:** a lightweight consent gate. `track()` is the natural enforcement point — buffer or drop events until consent is granted, and only initialize `fbq`/`gtag` post-consent (Consent Mode v2 for GA4).
- Exact consent UX / whether a CMP is required depends on the client's legal stance — **flag in §11.** MVP ships the adapter consent-ready even if the banner is deferred.
